title: Lovely Light Argentinian Lamb Tagine
description: A charred and springy Argentinian dish featuring ground nutmeg and cooked in a tagine, perfect for a monsoon evening, this recipe is shojin-friendly and serves as a great dinner option
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute
Add the ground lamb and cook until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks
Add the paprika, salt, black pepper, and ground nutmeg, and stir to combine
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer
Cover the tagine and transfer it to the oven, where it will cook for 1 1/2 hours
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
